quests.name: The Death Knights' Hearts
quests.offer: The Plague Lord's realm opens to few. Bring me the hearts of three death knights who walk Tunaria: Endraval, Bileheart and Halik. And see my assistant Xeptip first: you will need a suit.
quests.accept: I will bring you their hearts.
quests.declined: The dead are patient. I am not.
quests.started: Go. Xeptip waits beside me.

steps.journal: Speak with Necrologist Xeptip, beside Zizclank in the Dead Hills.
steps.says: A suit of zombie flesh, sewn tight. Carry it whenever you go to the Plague Lord. The dead there do not question their own.

steps.journal: Kill Deathknight Endraval among the dead trees west of Takish'Hiz and take his heart.
Kill Deathknight Bileheart in the rift of dead trees in Salisearaneen and take his heart.
Kill Deathknight Halik at the ring of rune stones south of Blackwater and take his heart.
Bring the three death knights' hearts to Necrologist Zizclank in the Dead Hills.
steps.says: Three hearts, cold as the grave. The mausoleum will open to you now.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its first half. The guide's zombie flesh suit is crafted or bought at auction in the live game; nothing sells one here, so Xeptip hands one over. The guide lets the hearts be taken before the quest is logged; here each drops on its step, in the guide's order (Endraval, Bileheart, Halik). Deathknight Endraval is FrontiersForge's sighting (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json); Bileheart is the game's Deathknight Blieheart, his heart Corin Bileheart's.

quests.name: The Last House
quests.offer: Beyond the mausoleum's portal lies the Last House, where plague is tended like a garden. Find your way through it to its far portal, and the Plane of Disease will be open to you.
quests.declined: Then keep the hearts' cold company.
quests.started: The mausoleum is in the middle of the tomb yard.

steps.journal: Show your zombie flesh suit to the portal in the mausoleum of the Dead Hills' tomb yard.
steps.says: The portal ripples, tastes the dead flesh, and pulls you through.

steps.journal: Speak with Fatima in the Last House's entrance hall.
steps.says: A visitor? The orderlies do not like visitors. There, they have seen you.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House orderlies that turn on you.
Go to the end of the hall with the three bathtubs, as Fatima told you.

events.text: The water in the three bathtubs is black and still. Someone is tending it, and does not want to be disturbed.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House healer at the bathtubs.
Go on past Fatima and find Rebo, along the east hall.
steps.says: You should not be here. Orderlies!

steps.journal: Kill the orderlies Rebo called down on you.
Return to Fatima.
steps.says: Rebo will not help you. The pharmacist keeps the wasp venom: bring it to me.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House pharmacist and take his wasp venom.
Bring the wasp venom to Fatima.
steps.says: Good. Medelonia knows the way on. Go to her.

steps.journal: Speak with Medelonia in the middle hall.
steps.says: The physician wears the only robe the orderlies obey. Take it from him.

steps.journal: Kill the Last House physician and take his robe.
Wearing the robe, talk to the orderly at the end of the small hallway off the physician's room.
steps.says: Physician? Through the wall, then. Up the ramp and along the halls to the portal.

steps.journal: Go up the ramp and along the halls to the Last House's portal and pass through.
steps.says: The portal opens onto the Plane of Disease.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its second half; finishing it flags the player for Zizclank's trip to PoD (unlocks). The Last House is placed in PoD's small closed building in the south-west (no walk enters it): its halls at y -12, the far side of the wall the west wing at -1.3; every spot there is ours. The orderlies stand white-faced and turn hostile by spawn events (two each time, where the guide says two or three); the bathtub popup, the healer, the pharmacist and the physician stand in their rooms; the walk through the far side is cut to the portal by the landing. The guide's rule that the trip needs the flesh suit every time is not modelled (unlocks only). The guide names no reward but the flag.

quests.name: The Whirling Portal
quests.offer: The whirling portal in the lake goes to the Queen's hive, but it opens to no stranger. Clear the lake's shore and speak to it. Then see Bonefisher Chklurgl in his tent north of the lake.
quests.accept: I will speak to the portal.
quests.declined: Then the lake keeps its secret.
quests.started: Mind the lake. Something lives in it.

steps.journal: Clear the creatures by the lake and speak to the whirling portal.
steps.says: A hum rises from the portal: the lake is sick, and something in it feeds on the puslings.

steps.journal: Speak with Bonefisher Chklurgl in his tent north of the lake.
steps.says: Something in lake eat puslings! You swim out over portal, look in mud. Kill what comes.

steps.journal: Swim out over the lake by the whirling portal and inspect the mud.

events.text: You stir the mud with your hand. It boils, and filth squids rise around you!

steps.journal: Kill the filth squids that rose from the mud.
Kill Sthlumchoxius, the kraken that kills the puslings.
Return to Bonefisher Chklurgl.
steps.says: Lake quiet again! Take chitin from Queen's hive. Show to portal: it lets you through.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Queen Qy'tha Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 1-8; finishing it flags the player for the whirling portal's trip to the wasp hive (unlocks); the chitin is the guide's keepsake. The sacrifice swim (the popup's choice, deaths and rezzes), the ten minutes before Sthlumchoxius rises and the kill group's flag are simplified: the squids (four, the guide's) and Sthlumchoxius are spawned hostile beside the player at once. The 500 experience is the guide's; the faction with the puslings is ours (the guide's scepter needs a positive standing with them and names no other way to it).

quests.name: The Queen's Stinger
quests.offer: The Bonefisher gave you the chitin. The whirling portal will take you to the wasp hive now. Kill Queen Qy'tha among her children and bring her stinger to me.
quests.accept: I will bring you her stinger.
quests.started: Mind her wasps. They will see you coming.

steps.journal: Take the whirling portal to the wasp hive, kill Queen Qy'tha and take her stinger.
Bring Queen Qy'tha's stinger to Witchdoctor Muglchlur by the lake.
steps.says: The Queen's stinger! Keep it safe. The puslings will remember this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Queen Qy'tha Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 9-10. The tormented caddis farmed until she spawns are left out: the Queen stands always up here. The guide's totem for the stinger needs a positive standing with the puslings (its Bertoxxulous section): that exchange is the next quest. The faction is ours, as the first part's.

quests.name: Bertoxxulous and the Throne of Plague
quests.offer: You are a friend of the puslings now. Give me the Queen's stinger and I will make a scepter of it. Show the scepter to the Throne of Bertoxxulous, past the Bloody Portal, and he will come.
quests.started: Bring your strongest. He is one tough foe.

steps.journal: Give Queen Qy'tha's stinger to Witchdoctor Muglchlur.
steps.says: There. The scepter of plague. The throne will answer it.

steps.journal: Take the Bloody Portal to the Twins' valley and show the scepter of plague to the Throne of Bertoxxulous.
steps.says: The throne shudders, and the Plaguebringer turns to face you.

events.text: Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer rises from his throne. He has noticed you.

steps.journal: Kill Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The scepter is the guide's, for the stinger, with a positive standing with the puslings (factions_required). Bertoxxulous stands always up here (the guide's every-three-days throne is not modelled), so the scepter only wakes him. The guide gives no quest reward: his loot is his.

quests.name: The Fuming Portal
quests.offer: Noroxus! Ulgurglch masters want him dead. Kill the toxic slimes in the three pools round the cauldron and bring three slime hearts. Take a viturille skin too: no skin, no going through.
quests.started: Three pools, three hearts. Go!

steps.journal: Take a viturille skin from the cillieane viturilles by the nox pools.
Kill the toxic pollutive slime in each of the three nox pools round the cauldron and take its heart.
Bring the three slime hearts to Honcho Ulgurglch.
steps.says: Three hearts! Ulgurglch mix them... there. Take to big cauldron in middle of pools.

steps.journal: Kill the plague toxicologists round the great cauldron among the three pools.
Give the fused slime heart to the fuming portal at the cauldron.
steps.says: The cauldron boils over, and the fuming portal opens.

events.text: Green smoke pours from the cauldron and the fuming portal flares open. Beyond it waits Noroxus.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Noroxus Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Steps 1-5; finishing it flags the player for the fuming portal's trip to Noroxus (unlocks). The guide's giver line names Honcho Oogurlgze, its steps Honcho Ulgurglch, the game's name. The slimes stand in the pools (the guide's connable slime that spawns them is not modelled); the skin is the guide's pass, its portal check is the flag; the goo that debuffs Noroxus, the portal's 10-15 minutes and 'Noroxus must be up' are left out.

quests.name: Blood of Noroxus
quests.offer: The fuming portal is open to you. Go through and kill Noroxus. His blood opens the closed portal, the Bloody Portal, round the ring past Ulgurglch: the way to the twins.
quests.started: Stand behind him. His breath goes only forward.

steps.journal: Take the fuming portal to Noroxus's lair, kill Noroxus and take his blood.
Show the blood of Noroxus to the Bloody Portal, round the ring past Honcho Ulgurglch.
steps.says: The closed portal drinks a drop of the blood and opens. Keep the rest: it opens every time.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Noroxus Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Step 7 and its reward: the blood of Noroxus opens the Bloody Portal to the twins (unlocks; the item is kept, as the guide's 'unlimited use').

quests.name: Yarfsnoogle's Anatomy
quests.offer: Yarfsnoogle studies the rot! Bring eight pieces: femur, organ, skin, tibia, skull, gland, eyeball and soul dust. The great ones of this plane each carry one.
quests.declined: Rot waits for no one. Yarfsnoogle waits.
quests.started: Eight pieces! Go, go.

steps.journal: Kill Rallius Rattican, the robed rat of the entrance valleys, and take a fetid rotting femur.
Kill the Lich Overlord behind the tree by the banker in the first tunnel and take a fetid rotting organ.
Kill Fleshripper, the vulture of the second valley, and take a fetid rotting skin.
Kill Gluboxious the Fetid in the lake past the second tunnel and take a fetid rotting tibia.
Kill Rawgl the Carnage Hound by the nox pools and take a fetid rotting skull.
Kill Noroxus in his lair and take a fetid rotting gland.
Kill Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer and take his soul dust.
Kill Queen Qy'tha in the wasp hive and take a fetid rotting eyeball.
Bring the eight pieces to Yarfsnoogle in the nox pools' camp.
steps.says: All eight! Yarfsnoogle teaches you. But Grum is not pleased...

steps.journal: Kill Grum, who attacks as Yarfsnoogle finishes.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Each piece is its giver's primary drop in the guide (Rotwood the Hollow's skull and the secondary drops aside), a sure drop on its step, in the guide's order but for the eyeball last; the rare spawns stand always up here. Each class's PoD ability is the spell the guide lists for it, as this server spells it (the rogue's 'Virulet Blade' is Virulent Blade Assassin, the same figures; the shaman's two spells both); the cleric's Purifying Winds of Nife has no spellpattern row, so a cleric gets Grum's robe alone. Grum's drop is the guide's item for the class as a reward on his kill: the shield (war, pal, sk) and the robe (casters, healers, monk); the helms, tunics and boots it lists for rangers, rogues and bards have no itempattern rows. Yarfsnoogle's pet's bag is left out.

quests.name: The Plague Weapons
quests.offer: The four great insects of this valley grow fat on plague. Bring me wax dust from the Moth Monarch, bile from the Locust Monarch, and the legs and mandibles of the two Matriarchs.
quests.started: Larvae first, then the great ones.

steps.journal: Kill the Moth Monarch in the pocket of seven pools and take its wax dust.
Kill the Locust Monarch and take its acidic blood bile.

items.item: front legs of the Mantis Matriarch

steps.journal: Kill the Mantis Matriarch and take her front legs.
Kill the Millipede Matriarch and take her mandibles.

items.item: front legs of the Mantis Matriarch

steps.journal: Bring the four pieces to Witchdoctor Yurplag.
steps.says: All four! Yurplag makes you a weapon worthy of this plane.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Weapon Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The larvae, mid-level spawns and despawning bosses of the guide's cycle are left out: the four bosses stand always up here, each a sure drop. The rewards are the guide's by archetype (Tank the Gory Cleaver of Mavis, Caster the Totem of Avhi, Healer the Totem of Tolawon, the game's Toluwon); The Bloodsabre (rangers, rogues, bards) and the Thorn of Deatharn (monks) have no itempattern rows, so those classes get nothing yet. The guide's 'some small xp' has no figure.

quests.name: Plagueswine Tusks
quests.offer: The plague swine in these valleys grow fine tusks. Bring me four and I will pay you well, as often as you like.
quests.started: Four tusks, then.

steps.journal: Take four plagueswine tusks from the plague swine of the second valley.
Bring four plagueswine tusks to Tuskmaster Helgley in the tents by the first pond.
steps.says: Fine tusks. Here is your pay. Bring more any time.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its note on Tuskmaster Helgley's hunt and gather: 250,000 experience (the guide's 'about 250k') and 956 tunar for four tusks, no faction with the puslings (the guide's own words). The drop chance is ours.

quests.name: Scuzz Toad Eyes
quests.offer: Scuzz toads in the lakes past the second tunnel have good eyes for stew. Bring Pluxklez four, and Pluxklez gives stew. Again and again!
quests.started: Four eyes!

steps.journal: Take four scuzz toad eyes from the scuzz toads in Gluboxious's lake.
Bring four scuzz toad eyes to Pluxklez, where the Lich Overlord spawns.
steps.says: Good eyes! Here, stew. Eat it, feel better.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-disease.json, ## Plane of Disease Spell Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Its note on Pluxklez: 251,000 experience and scuzz toad stew for four eyes (the guide's figures). The scuzz toads' spawn cycle from the jellies and piranhas is left out: they stand at the lake (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json); the stew takes the sondereel fish soup's effect, not the guide's 156 a tick; the drop chance is ours.

quests.name: The Manticores' Riddles
quests.offer: The way to the sky is guarded by riddles, little one: two of mine, and two each of my kin, Alexandraphex and Fentharos, on the hills nearby. Hear theirs, then answer mine.
quests.declined: The sky can wait for the wise.
quests.started: Mine: a beast that was a man lies cold north of Anu's pond, serving masters not of the dead. Bring me the ice of the earth he holds.

steps.journal: Hear Alexandraphex's riddle on the hillside west of Sektamoot.
steps.says: Mine: something black lives under a blue horizon, a thorn sunk in its swollen flesh. Many arms have pulled at it in vain. Bring me the thorn.

steps.journal: Hear Fentharos's riddle on the hillside east of Sektamoot.
steps.says: Mine: old armour round muscle and bone, a dragon with no wings, and a hunter's name in its belly. Bring me that name.

steps.journal: Kill Skaldi Runehoof in the tomb by the pond north of Anu Village and take the totem of the frozen north.
Bring the totem of the frozen north to Sektamoot.
steps.says: The ice of the earth, from the hand of the dead. The first riddle is answered.

steps.journal: Kill Kratas, the beast of the deep sea south of Tunaria, and pull the harpoon of Telinan from his hide.
Bring the harpoon of Telinan to Alexandraphex.
steps.says: The thorn, free at last. You have answered me.

steps.journal: Kill Crocosaurus at the crocodile rocks on Lake Noregard's temple island and take the ring of Garthis.
Bring the ring of Garthis to Fentharos.
steps.says: Garthis, the hunter who fell to the beast. Return to Sektamoot: there is more.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The first three riddles (the guide lets them be solved in any order; here Sektamoot's, Alexandraphex's, then Fentharos's). The riddles are ours, after the guide's. The three manticores stand on hillsides of the Sphinx Pyramid's NE ninth, ours (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json); Kratas and Crocosaurus are FrontiersForge's sightings, standing here (the Kratas quest that spawns him is Misc's). The harpoon is made from Lord Pickclaw's Scepter's look.

quests.name: The Manticores' Tokens
quests.offer: Now my second: guarded by the brood of desert and wind, bedded in sand and gold, a fist of death carved in stone. My kin have their second riddles for you too. Bring all three, and a token each.
quests.declined: Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go. And do not come back without all three.

steps.journal: Kill Skahyir in the cave guarded by two inferno drakes in Box Canyons and take the crown of Rargek.
Bring the crown of Rargek to Sektamoot.
steps.says: The crown of the Deathfist king. Take my token.

steps.journal: Kill Lady Vox atop her castle in Permafrost and take the shawl of the winter queen.
Bring the shawl of the winter queen to Alexandraphex.
steps.says: Spun by the blue-skinned cursed for their banished mistress. My token.

steps.journal: Kill Siliskor in the canyon pit with the tilted statue in the Elephant Graveyard and take the shield of King Jorat.
Bring the shield of King Jorat to Fentharos.
steps.says: A king's shield, praised among the sleeping ivory. My token.

steps.journal: Bring the three manticore tokens to Sektamoot.
steps.says: Three tokens. Now find the way to the sky yourself: it waits atop the Endless Tower.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The last three riddles, each item for a token. Skahyir, Lady Vox and Siliskor stand always up here (the guide's days-long camps are not modelled); the riddles are ours, after the guide's.

quests.name: The Endless Tower
quests.offer: The portal to the sky forms for the worthy at the top of the Endless Tower, where the monks live, in the Eternal Desert. Go up. Sarathet waits on the other side.
quests.started: Go. Up, and through.

steps.journal: Climb to the top of the Endless Tower in the Eternal Desert.

events.text: The wind at the top of the tower gathers into a shimmering ring. A portal forms before you.

steps.journal: Step through the Sky Portal atop the Endless Tower.
steps.says: The sky opens around you.

steps.journal: Speak with Sarathet, the great manticore, on the Plane of Sky.
steps.says: So the manticores of the Rathe sent you. Keep this eye with you, and the tower's portal will always let you through.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The tower and Sarathet (the game's Sartheret); finishing it flags the player for the Sky Portal's trip to the Plane of Sky (unlocks). The guide's reward for a wizard or druid is a group portal spell to the Plane of Sky: no such spell is in spellpattern (nor a spellgates row), so every class gets the Eye of the Sphynx, the guide's reward for the others; its 'carried each time' is not checked. No experience, as the guide says.

quests.name: The Key of Rain
quests.offer: Rain is the gentlest of the chains, they say. A rain key is two thousand tunar. Take it to the essence of rain across the bridge, and see what waits beyond.
quests.started: Across the bridge, then.

steps.journal: Buy a rain key from Liztin Misseliania for 2,000 tunar.
steps.says: One rain key. Mind the essence: it is fussy.

steps.journal: Cross the bridge north-west and use the rain key on the essence of rain.
steps.says: The essence takes the key and the rain takes you.

steps.journal: Hunt the first isle of rain until you find Artiokanis, and kill him.

factions: Denizens of the Plane of Sky

steps.journal: Use the keys Artiokanis dropped on the isle's essence of rain.
steps.says: The essence carries you on.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Rain Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Rain 1. Artiokanis's eight keys are the passage, here the essence's own teleport; the shards (for the Constructs, not in) are left out. The faction for Artiokanis is ours: Rain 2's Trixie needs -99 with the plane's people (the guide names no way to it), and the Denizens start at -349.

quests.name: Sterie Glitterlight
factions_required: Denizens of the Plane of Sky
quests.offer: Sterie Glitterlight is missing on the other side of the maze! Please find her. Keep right in the maze and it lets you out.
quests.started: Right wall, remember!

steps.journal: Go through the maze, keeping to the right wall, and find Sterie Glitterlight on the far side.
steps.says: You found me! Oh no, behind you...

steps.journal: Kill Kaglanor, the spirit by the maze's ruined wall.
Return through the maze, keeping to the left wall, to Trixie Longwings.
steps.says: Sterie is safe! Take this wand: it makes keys for the essence.

steps.journal: Use the wand's keys on the essence of rain.
steps.says: The essence opens.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Rain Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Rain 2. The guide's -99 faction is taken to be the Denizens of the Plane of Sky's (factions_required). The wand that makes eight keys is the essence's teleport; the gargoyles of the maze are left to the player; Kaglanor stands where he spawns.

quests.name: The Necrologist of Rain
quests.offer: The qex in our trees carry wings I need. Bring me four. Then perhaps you will help me with something worse in the cave below.
quests.started: They roam the trees. They take a while to kill.

steps.journal: Take four qex wings from the forest qex in the trees of the isle.
Bring four qex wings to Singe Burnfeathers in the lower hut.
steps.says: Good. Now the cave with the flesh maggots: something lives at its bottom. Go down.

steps.journal: Go down the flesh maggots' cave to the great cavern, kill Ghizilanve and take her black gem.
Bring the black gem to Singe Burnfeathers.
steps.says: Narciliisisin's gem! That necrologist must die. This wand makes keys for the essence.

steps.journal: Use the wand's keys on the essence of rain down the road from the village.
steps.says: The essence opens onto an isle of demions.

steps.journal: Circle the isle of demions to the far side, by its portal, until the necrologist shows himself.

events.text: A cold laugh rises among the demions. The necrologist Narciliisisin steps out of the dark.

steps.journal: Kill the necrologist Narciliisisin.
Kill the Spirit of Narciliisisin.
Take the isle's essence of rain on to the last isle.
Kill Chimareon the Tyrant, far ahead of where you came in.
Take the essence of rain to the Isle of Wonder.
Speak with the Manifestation of Rain on the Isle of Wonder.
steps.says: You have walked the whole chain of rain. Take my key: it brings you back any time.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Rain Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Rain 3 to 5 and the Manifestation of Rain: finishing it flags the player for Rain 1 from the main island's essence of rain (unlocks: the guide's free key). Granavik the bugbeast and every shard (for the Constructs, not in) are left out; the necrologist's popup is a reach step by him; the wands' keys are the essences' teleports. The Manifestation of Rain is ours (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json). The guide gives no reward but the flag.

quests.name: The Key of the Sun
quests.offer: The sun chain is harder than the rain: the sycophants see through your tricks. A sun key is two thousand tunar. The essence of the sun stands by the Isle of Wonder's portal.
quests.started: Mind the fairies.

steps.journal: Buy a sun key from Liztin Misseliania for 2,000 tunar.
steps.says: One sun key. Good luck.

steps.journal: Use the sun key on the essence of the sun, near the Isle of Wonder's portal.
steps.says: Light swallows you.

steps.journal: Kill the brightstar fairies until the brightstar princess comes, and kill her.
Use the princess's key on the isle's essence of day.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Sun Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Sun 1. The guide's Essence of Day on the main island is the game's essence of sun; the princess stands always up here; her keys are the essence's teleport; the shards are left out.

quests.name: Master Fiharaz's Door
quests.offer: I can open the secret way for you, but first kill three of the imps outside my castle and bring me one of their talismans.
quests.accept: I will bring you a talisman.
quests.started: Three imps, one talisman.

steps.journal: Kill three imerzan sycophants outside Master Fiharaz's castle and take a talisman.
Bring the imerzan talisman to Master Fiharaz in his tower.
steps.says: Good. The ramp that goes nowhere across the courtyard: walk through it.

steps.journal: Go down through the ramps and bridges past the courtyard and kill Imerzan.
Use Imerzan's key on the essence of day.
Kill whispering and whistling winds until a wailing wind comes, and kill it.
Kill the Torrential Wind that follows.
Use the wailing wind's key on the essence of day.
Kill the rapacious drakes until the rancorous drake comes, and kill it.
Kill Randarin the Relentless.
Take the essence of day on the far side of the isle to the Isle of Wonder.
Speak with the Manifestation of Dreams on the Isle of Wonder.
steps.says: The chain of the sun is yours. Come back whenever you like.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Sun Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Sun 2 to 4 and the Manifestation of Dreams: finishing it flags the player for Sun 1 from the essence of sun (unlocks). The winds' and drakes' placeholder cycles are left out (each stands always up here); Randarin and the Torrential Wind are the guide's shard spawns, killed here for the chain; the keys are the essences' teleports. No reward but the flag.

quests.name: The Chain of Night
quests.offer: The night chain asks nothing of you first, only a key of the ancients: three thousand tunar. Its essence stands south of my hut.
quests.started: South of my hut.

steps.journal: Buy a key of the ancients from Liztin Misseliania for 3,000 tunar.
steps.says: One key of the ancients. The night is long.

steps.journal: Use the key of the ancients on the essence of night south of Liztin's hut.
steps.says: Darkness folds round you.

steps.journal: Kill the four ancient peasants.
Kill the three ancient vassals.
Kill the three ancient denizens.
Kill the ancient squire by the exit portal.
Kill the ancient jester.
Take the essence of night to the next isle.
Get past the golems to the far end of the isle and kill the Iron Knight.
Take the essence of night on.
Save the maiden: kill Arch Bishop Millian in his tower.
Kill Arch Bishop Lancel before the dukes reach the maiden.
Speak with the Night Maiden at the top.
steps.says: You saved me. Go: the portal behind you is open.

steps.journal: Kill the dark barons and essences along the edges until the dark baroness comes, and kill her.
Cross the isle along the edges to its essence of night.
Climb into King Ruthra's pyramid past his squires, mages and bishops, and kill him.
Take the essence of night on the temple's second floor to the Isle of Wonder.
Speak with the Mark of the Majestic on the Isle of Wonder.
steps.says: The night is yours, and the snow is open to you. Come to me when you want its key.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Night Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Night 1 to 5 and the Mark of the Majestic: finishing it flags the player for Night 1 (unlocks) and opens the Snow chain (its quest requires this one). The Voice of the Ancients that calls the waves is left out (the ancients stand always up here); the maiden's popup and her dukes' race are cut to the two bishops the guide says to kill; the barons and essences before the baroness are the player's own; every shard is left out; the keys are the essences' teleports. No reward but the flag.

quests.name: The Chain of Snow
quests.offer: You have walked the night. Now the snow: I will open its first isle to you. Ryini waits there, lost and far from her town. Be ready before you speak to her.
quests.started: Ryini waits. Do not speak to her until you are ready.

steps.journal: Before you go down, take an eye from the icebound gargoyles of the first isle of snow.
Speak with Ryini where you came in, and keep her safe down the mountain corridor.
steps.says: You will take me home to Tamis? Keep the gargoyles off me.

steps.journal: Kill the wind mephit that comes at the stone bridge.
Follow Ryini down the corridor to the end of the road and speak with her.
steps.says: There is the village below. Tamis is in the igloos. Thank you!

steps.journal: Speak with Tamis in the igloos of the village below.
steps.says: Ryini is home! Now kill the whirlwind that circles the village.

steps.journal: Kill the Whirlwind on the outskirts of the igloo village.
Speak with Guenzi in the igloos about a stew.
steps.says: A stew for the drake mother: an ape's heart, a drake's foot and a gargoyle eye.

steps.journal: Take the essence of snow to the next isle.
Climb east away from the behemoths and hunt them for an ape's heart.
Kill the Glacial Champion far to the south to open the isle's portal.
Take the essence of snow to the last isle.
Hunt the celestial drakes for a drake's foot.
Take the essence of snow back to the igloo village.
Bring the ape's heart, drake's foot and gargoyle eye to Guenzi.
steps.says: There. The stew. Carry it near where the drake mother sleeps.

steps.journal: Walk slowly toward where Aeyinar rests, with the stew.

events.text: The smell of the stew carries across the snow. Aeyinar wakes, and she is enraged.

steps.journal: Kill Enraged Aeyinar.
Take the essence of the brood back to the Isle of Wonder.
Speak with the Mark of the Majestic again.
steps.says: The snow is yours, and desolation is open to you. The Mark of Desolation will send you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Snow Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Isles 1 to 4 and Enraged Aeyinar: the Mark of the Majestic's snow key is the accept's teleport to Snow 1, and finishing it flags the player for Snow 1 from the Mark (unlocks) and opens the Desolation chain. Ryini's escort is talks either side of the wind mephit (she does not walk); the drop down the waterfall to the village and the guide's back-and-forth between isles are teleports; the herb is left out (the guide's stew without it); Enraged Aeyinar stands always up and her 15 minutes are not kept. The essences' names in the guide (Icicles, Snowfall, the Brood) are the game's essence of snow. No reward but the flag.

quests.name: The Chain of Desolation
quests.offer: Aeyinar has fallen to you. Desolation is the last chain, and the hardest: four isles, and the Quintessence of Veeshan at their end. I will send you to the first.
quests.started: Mind your resists. Lightning, then poison.

steps.journal: Farm the scouts and scavengers of each quarter of the isle and kill the erych patrollers.
Kill the five erych guardians that come in their place.
Kill the Erych Arbiter in the druid ring.
Take the portal at the north end of the isle.
Speak with the Elder of the aviak village.
steps.says: Narcillian's soldiers come for us! Defend the village, stranger.

steps.journal: Defend the village: kill Narcillian's scouts.
Defend the village: kill Narcillian's warriors.
Kill the Warlord of Narcillian.
Run for the orb on the portal pad, past the harpies.
Kill the dark and light harpies of the isle.
Kill the Harpy Queen when she comes down on you.
Take the orb to the last isle of desolation.
Kill the Quintessence of Veeshan.
Go through the astral portal on the mountain top.
Speak with the Mark of Desolation on the Isle of Wonder.
steps.says: You have walked the whole Plane of Sky. Few ever have.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Desolation Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Desolation 1 to 4. The Mark sends the player at the accept (the guide's 'speak to an npc up there'); the patrollers (four on this server, five in the guide), guardians and Arbiter stand always up (the quarters' placeholders and her three deaths are not modelled); the village's six waves are the scouts and warriors this server has; the shards and the Constructs are left out. The guide gives no reward but the plane's completion.

quests.name: The Medallion of the Faceless
quests.offer: The Isle of Dread is the Faceless One's. I take there only those who carry his medallion, and for ten thousand tunar every time. Kill a dreadnaught and bring me its medallion.
quests.declined: Then stay where it is safe.
quests.started: Hide from its breath behind the rocks, and strike between.

steps.journal: Kill a dreadnaught south-east of Anu Village in Permafrost and take the Medallion of the Faceless.
Bring the Medallion of the Faceless and 10,000 tunar to Norach, on the islet in the lake south of Cazic Thule's temple.
steps.says: The Faceless knows you now. For ten thousand tunar I take you to his isle, every time.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/isle-of-dread.json, ## Isle of Dread (IoD) Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Finishing it flags the player for Norach's trip to the Isle of Dread (unlocks: the route should take the guide's 10,000 tunar each time); the first trip is the hand-in's own (a teleport to Graumord, the isle's town, ours).

quests.name: Cleansing the Isle
quests.offer: We of Graumord trust no one who has not bled for us. Cazic's creatures crawl over the pit east of town: kill them, and come back. Do it often enough and we will speak of more.
quests.declined: Then you are no friend of ours.
quests.started: Mind the breath stealers.

steps.journal: Kill five dread rots in the pit east of Graumord.
Kill five wicker men in the pit east of Graumord.
Return to a Graumord citizen.
steps.says: That will thin them. Graumord remembers.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/isle-of-dread.json, ## QUEST: Beginning (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Ours: the guide raises the citizens' standing by 'killing all mobs but sacrifice and citizen of graumord on the isle', and this server has no faction hits for the isle's creatures, so this repeatable stands in for them (+40 a time from the -150 start; four times makes it positive). Drop it if faction hits for the isle are seeded.

quests.name: The Faceless Generals
quests.offer: At last, someone who has stood against Cazic's treachery. Will you fight on and free the souls he has imprisoned? Kill his three faceless generals at the citadel and bring me their essences.
quests.started: The generals keep to the top of the tower. Lure them down.

steps.journal: Kill Dread, a faceless general, high in the citadel's tower, and take his essence.
Kill Fright in the citadel's tower and take his essence.
Kill Terror in the citadel's tower and take his essence.
Bring the three essences to the Graumord citizen in the inn.
steps.says: Their essences, made into Cazic's own scent. Never part with it: the Estate's door will know you by it, and its guardian will come for you.

steps.journal: Carry Cazic's Scent to the front door of Cazic Thule's Estate, kill The Guardian and take its heart.
Go downstairs in Cazic Thule's Estate and speak with Kithgrin.
steps.says: You come with the Guardian's heart. Then the trials may begin.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/isle-of-dread.json, ## QUEST: Beginning (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The giver is the inn's unattackable citizen of the guide; this server's twenty Graumord citizens are one name. A positive standing with the Citizens of Graumord (factions_required), as the guide says; the kill group's loot of the heart is the questor's own.

quests.name: The Trials of Cazic Thule
quests.offer: Three trials stand between you and the Faceless: endurance, celerity and contention. The first: go down the long hallway alone, and survive what comes for you.
quests.started: Alone, mind. The others wait upstairs.

steps.journal: Go down the long hallway alone.

events.text: The air thickens. Thoughtbleeders swarm out of the walls around you.

steps.journal: Survive the trial of endurance: kill the six thoughtbleeders.
Return to Kithgrin for the trial of celerity.
steps.says: The trial of celerity: in the catacombs, Qual'Tin waits. Let your friends strike first.

steps.journal: Go into the catacombs, to the room with the pool, and kill Qual'Tin.
Return to Kithgrin for the trial of contention.
steps.says: The last trial: face the contempt in your own head. Defeat the Watchman, and find his flaw.

steps.journal: Kill the Watchman as he walks the halls.
Go into the main chamber with the great lava pool and take a gem from the enraged phantasms.
Carry the gem into the Statue of CazicThule's room.

events.text: You set the phantasm's gem into the statue. Its stone face cracks, and CazicThule wakes.

steps.journal: Kill CazicThule, the god of fear.
Return to Kithgrin.
steps.says: You have passed every trial and faced the Faceless. Take this talisman; come to me when it runs low.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/isle-of-dread.json, ## Trial One: Trial of Endurance (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). and the guide's Trial Two, Trial Three, Statue and God of Fear sections. The thirty minutes of thoughtbleeders are their six kills; the Trial of Celerity's trigger and its red named spawns are left out (Qual'Tin stands always up); the guide's Watchman is the game's The Watchmen; the enraged phantasms stand always up and the statue's popup is a reach step; CazicThule stands always up. The guide's reward, a self port of 500 charges to the isle, is Kithgrin's talisman here: no item teleports on this server, so it is a keepsake (see the report).

quests.name: The Agent of Tranquility
quests.offer: Breathe. Let your fears, your sadness and your anger go. Good. Now carry that calm to others: Bobble-by-Water and Merry-by-Water quarrel. Begin with Kayle in Bobble-by-Water.
quests.accept: I have no more fears, sadness or anger.
quests.declined: Then sit, and begin again when you are ready.
quests.started: Go gently.

steps.journal: Speak with Kayle in Bobble-by-Water, across the river from the coachman by the south wall.
steps.says: Talk with Merry-by-Water? No one even gets inside their walls.

steps.journal: Speak with Hayle on the west side of Merry-by-Water, by the wall.
steps.says: Meet Kayle? In Rivervale, perhaps... if she agrees first.

steps.journal: Return to Kayle in Bobble-by-Water and convince her to meet Hayle in Rivervale.
steps.says: Rivervale, then. Fine. For the towns' sake.

steps.journal: Return to the Agent of Tranquility at Shon-To Monastery.
steps.says: You brought calm where there was none. Take this stone, and the rune of my task.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Zaoran Plateau Entry Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Agent of Tranquility. The meditation is the offer's answer (the guide: say no to more fears). Both of the guide's Kayles are one name on this server (the Agent of Spite's stands under the tarp; this quest's is specced by the south wall), so either does a Kayle step. The stone is the guide's, and the rune (the guide's for a level 60, so the quest is level 60).

quests.name: The Agent of Spite
quests.offer: Kayle won the pie contest, and she is telling Bobloe how under the tarp by the river. Listen in, and come tell me something surprising.
quests.started: Under the tarp, by the river.

steps.journal: Listen in on Kayle's talk with Bobloe under the tarp north of the Agent of Spite.

events.text: ...and nobody noticed the berries were Hayle's, picked off her own vines! Kayle laughs. Bobloe does not.

steps.journal: Report what you heard to the Agent of Spite.
steps.says: Hayle's berries! Go and tell Hayle in Merry-by-Water. Slowly. Let it simmer.

steps.journal: Tell Hayle on the west side of Merry-by-Water what you overheard, and stir it.
steps.says: My berries? My prize? Oh, Kayle will hear from me.

steps.journal: Return to the Agent of Spite in Bobble-by-Water.
steps.says: Delicious. Take this stone, and the rune of my task.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Zaoran Plateau Entry Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Agent of Spite. The overheard talk's words are ours (the guide gives none); the stone and the rune are the guide's.

quests.name: The Agent of Honor
quests.offer: Marr's war needs blades. The Scribe of Marr, beside me, will tell you of three of the enemy's that must fall. Afterwards, come back to me.
quests.started: The Scribe first.

steps.journal: Speak with the Scribe of Marr by the lone tower south of Halas's tunnel.
steps.says: Three targets: the orcs outside Freeport, the sand giant siegemaster of Hazinak, and Runnyeye's superior head jailor. Bring their sword, rune and key.

steps.journal: Kill the orc sappers, siegemasters and commanders along the road out of Freeport's north gate for the Sticky Finger Sword.
Kill the sand giant siegemaster in Hazinak, away from the portal, and take his Rallosian rune.
Kill the Superior Head Jailor in Runnyeye and take his titanium key.
Bring the sword, the rune and the key to the Scribe of Marr.
steps.says: All three. Marr thanks you. Now the Agent has a task of his own.

steps.journal: Speak with the Agent of Honor again.
steps.says: One more: Lord Pickclaw's scepter. Yalie Keylotta in Highpass knows the way to him.

steps.journal: Kill Lord Pickclaw in Highpass Hold and take his scepter.
Bring Lord Pickclaw's Scepter to the Agent of Honor.
steps.says: The pickclaws are leaderless. Take the rune of my task.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Zaoran Plateau Entry Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Agent of Honor. The 40,000 tunar and 4.5 million experience are the guide's; the orc camp is one spec, Orc Sapper (the guide's sappers, siegemasters and commanders), the siegemaster, the jailor (the guide's superior jailors' cycle left out) and Lord Pickclaw are specs (Yalie Keylotta's own quest to him is Misc's). The Agent of Honor's rune has no itempattern row: made like the others.

quests.name: The Agent of War
quests.offer: You want the plateau? Then show me you can fight. Coach Rubgar runs the trial: three sets, each worse than the last. Speak to him when you are ready.
quests.declined: Then you are not ready for the plateau.
quests.started: Coach Rubgar is by the shore.

steps.journal: Speak with Coach Rubgar when you are ready for the first set.
steps.says: First set: one brawler. Go!

steps.journal: Kill the Rallosian brawler.
Speak with Coach Rubgar for the second set.
steps.says: Second set: a brawler and his cleric. Kill the cleric first!

steps.journal: Kill the Rallosian cleric before he heals the brawler.
Speak with Coach Rubgar for the last set.
steps.says: Last set: four conjurers and their pets. Ignore the pets.

steps.journal: Kill the four Rallosian conjurers.
Speak with Coach Rubgar.
steps.says: Not bad. Here, a little coin and a gem. See the Agent.

steps.journal: Speak with the Agent of War again for your rune.
steps.says: You fought well. The rune of my task.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Zaoran Plateau Entry Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Agent of War. The guide ports the player to Lake Rathe E and then into a bubble; here Coach Rubgar stands by the agents (the map's point) and each set is spawned hostile beside the player; the set's names are ours (the guide's brawler, cleric and casters), and the second set's brawler leaves when its cleric falls. The guide's 'minor tunar' is 500 here (ours); the Gem of Battle has no itempattern row: made like the Spitestone, the same 30% stone.

quests.name: The Agent of Growth
quests.offer: The Rallosian portal on this hill is sick, and I mean to heal it. My gnomish intern has the theory. Talk to him first, then come back to me.
quests.started: He is just there.

steps.journal: Speak with the Agent of Growth's gnomish intern.
steps.says: The portal feeds on growth, see? Living things. The Agent knows the rest.

steps.journal: Return to the Agent of Growth.
steps.says: Good. My assistant will tell you what to gather.

steps.journal: Speak with the Agent of Growth's assistant.
steps.says: Three of the same thing. At your level: bitter roots, from the orcs outside Freeport.

steps.journal: Bring three bitter roots to the Agent of Growth's assistant.
steps.says: This will do. Use the device on the portal.

steps.journal: Use the Rallosian healing device on the Rallosian portal.
steps.says: The device hums, and the portal's light steadies.

steps.journal: Bring the empty device to the Agent of Growth's assistant.
steps.says: It worked! Here is your reward.

steps.journal: Speak with the Agent of Growth for your rune.
steps.says: The portal grows strong again. The rune of my task.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Zaoran Plateau Entry Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Agent of Growth. The level 60 list's bitter roots (the game's name; the guide's golden iron ore and pickclaw orbs are left out); the 500,000 experience and 1,500 tunar are the guide's; the intern, the assistant and the portal are specs on the map's points, their names ours (the guide's 'her gnomish intern', 'her Assistant', 'the portal').

quests.name: The Way to Zaoran Plateau
quests.offer: The plateau lets in only those the five agents trust. Show me their five runes, and pay a single tunar each time you pass.
quests.started: Five runes.

steps.journal: Show the five agents' runes to the portal guardian on Lake Rathe.
steps.says: Five runes. Pass, then. Remember the tunar.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/zaoran-plateau.json, ## Zaoran Plateau Entry Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The portal guardian: finishing it flags the player for his trip to Zaoran Plateau (unlocks; the route should take the guide's 1 tunar each time); the first trip is the hand-in's own, to the Secrets world's zone 5 by its port-in marker (ZP1). The runes are kept, as the guide's 'speak again with the Agent to get your rune' implies; the guide's old notes on picking a side are left out.

quests.name: The Fire Giant Magus
quests.offer: So, a giant who is not a giant. Wear my guards' shroud and I will hear you. Bring me the three signets of this mountain's lords, goblin, giant and kobold, and I will show you the way to Nagafen.
quests.started: Goblin, giant, kobold. Their lords carry the signets.

steps.journal: Kill the fire giant guards near the Fire Giant Magus until one drops a Giant Guardian Shroud.
Wear the Giant Guardian Shroud and speak with the Fire Giant Magus by the north bridge.
steps.says: Now you look like one of us. Bring the signets.

steps.journal: Kill a goblin lord of Solusek's Eye, King Grog, for the Twisted Goblinkind Signet.
Kill a giant lord, Reaver Thoran, for the Signet of Giantkind.
Kill a kobold lord, Chief Growlnar, for the Kobold Blood Signet.
Bring the three signets to the Fire Giant Magus.
steps.says: All three. Now prove you are stronger than I.

events.text: The Fire Giant Magus roars and raises his hands. Fight him!

steps.journal: Kill the Fire Giant Magus.
Speak with the Subdued Magus.
steps.says: You beat me. Take my pouch of tokens and hand them out; each one sends a raider to Nagafen. You go last.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/soluseks-eye.json, ## Lord Nagafen Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). A barbarian, an ogre or a troll alone (races), as the guide's shroud is theirs; finishing it flags the questor for the Subdued Magus's trip to Lord Nagafen (unlocks; land by Nagafen Teleport Arrive). One boss stands for each signet's list (King Grog, Reaver Thoran, Chief Growlnar), a sure drop; the shroud's chance is ours; the Magus respawning as Subdued is a Subdued Magus standing by him (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json). The guide's pouch of 50 charges is one port token here: its 49 more are not modelled (a stack would need a count the rewards do not take); the raid's tokens are the next quest's. Wearing the shroud is not checked.

quests.name: Passage to Lord Nagafen
quests.offer: You carry one of my tokens? Give it to me and I will send you to Nagafen's island. Unequip your weapons first, or he will not wait for you to be ready.
quests.started: Hand it over.

steps.journal: Give a Nagafen port token to the Subdued Magus.
steps.says: Go, then.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/soluseks-eye.json, ## Lord Nagafen Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The raid's passage: anyone with a port token (tradeable, the guide's handed-out gems) is sent to Lord Nagafen's island, by Nagafen Teleport Arrive.

quests.name: The Black Lotus
quests.offer: There is a way into Sarek's tower, they say, for one who knows the alteration of teleportation. I do not. Dalius of the mage guild might. Ask him.
quests.started: The mage guild, by the guildmaster.

steps.journal: Speak with Dalius in Qeynos, at the mage guild beside the guildmaster.
steps.says: Dryads, a geode talisman of forty carats, archons' hearts, a fortress in the Rathe Mountains... and a black lotus, which Merchant Gilgash sells. Bring them to me.

steps.journal: Kill the earthen dryads of Geomancer's Citadel for two dryad hearts.
Kill Sarek's Keeper on the bridge at the constructs' gate in Geomancer's Citadel and take the geode talisman.
Talk to an orb beside the bridge to reach the towers, kill Archon Vetash and take his fire archon heart.
Kill Archon Aereth in the other tower and take his earth archon heart.
Buy the elemental smelter (10,000) and the black lotus (250,000) of Merchant Gilgash in Freeport.
steps.says: A smelter and a lotus. Mind the lotus: it is worth more than you are.

steps.journal: Bring the hearts, the geode talisman, the smelter and the black lotus to Dalius.
steps.says: Smelt the hearts, set them in the talisman, the lotus over all... There. It will carry you to Sarek. Take care: he may be home.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/sarek-the-betrayer-port.json, ## Sarek or Black Lotus Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's recipe is the player's own (use the smelter, the talisman, the lotus); here Dalius Toziuf (the game's Dalius) makes it, and the finished talisman's first use is the hand-in's teleport to Sarek the Betrayer's tower in the water. Its reuse is not modelled: no item teleports here, and no travel NPC goes to the tower (see the report). Rudro Balenthorpe is FrontiersForge's sighting by Qeynos's blacksmith (tools/quests/npcs/qe.json); Merchant Gilgash's two wares are a give of 260,000 tunar (the guide's prices) at his window.

quests.name: The Dead Hills Port
quests.offer: Forgotten, they call me, and I would not be. Bring me four green soulstone gems from the Jal'Raeth of Envar, and I will teach you a way back to me, here in these hills.
quests.declined: Then forget me, as the others did.
quests.started: The basement of Envar. Mind the energy stones: they are no use any more.

steps.journal: Kill the Jal'Raeth commoners in the basement of Envar for four green soulstone gems.
Bring the four green soulstone gems to Fendren the Forgotten in the Dead Hills.
steps.says: Four. The Dead Hills will open to you whenever you call.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/fendren-the-forgotten.json, ## Dead Hills Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The reward is the guide's Dead Hills Port (a druid's and wizard's group port to Dead Hills SE): no spellpattern row has it, so the quest is a draft until the spell and its spellgates row are added. Fendren, his treants and the commoners are specs; the drop chance is ours.

quests.name: Envaric Ascension
quests.offer: The altar's voice: four brooches from the Grave Ushers atop the four towers, laid here; then the essences and breaths of the basements' masters laid on the other altar. Only then will you ascend.
quests.started: Four brooches, from the tops of the towers.

steps.journal: Kill a Grave Usher atop one of Envar's towers for the iron brooch.
Kill a Grave Usher atop another tower for the copper brooch.
Kill a Grave Usher atop another tower for the brass brooch.
Kill the last tower's Grave Usher for the bronze brooch.
Lay the four brooches on the altar in the NE tower's basement library.
steps.says: The brooches melt together into a talisman with room for two diamonds.

steps.journal: Kill Tal'Thir in the NW tower's basement for the astral essence.
Kill the Jal'Raeth Bishop in the NE tower's basement for the ethereal essence.
Kill High Priest Vorin in the SE tower's basement for the astral breath.
Kill the Jal'Raeth Patriarch in the SW library for the ethereal breath.
Lay the essences, the breaths and the talisman on the altar in the SW tower's basement.
steps.says: Two diamonds form in the talisman, and it becomes the Holy Symbol of Envar. Its price is your life; its gift, the ascension.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/envaric-ascension-quest.json, ## Envaric Ascension Portal Quest (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Part 1. The reward is the guide's Envaric Ascension (a druid's, necromancer's and wizard's group port to the first chamber of the Prophet's tower): no spellpattern row has it, so the quest is a draft until the spell and its spellgates row are added. Both altars, the Grave Ushers, Tal'Thir, Vorin, the Bishop and the Patriarch are specs in Envar's towers (the Rathe's cell south of the Dead Hills: four towers with basements at y 44-51), their guards left out; the two diamonds and the symbol's death are the altar's words. Part 2, the climb of the Prophet's tower with its gems, begins with the spell's port and is left out.
